svg.text: The same warm palette, chunky outlines and rosy cheeks. Six new shapes and expressions.

g.text: A wider shell and a bigger, softer face.
A taller silhouette with an attentive little face.
A playful tilt and one very knowing wink.
A happy little cheerleader for your next idea.
Soft sleepy eyes and a tiny satisfied smile.
An angled shell with a face that peeks to the side.

svg.text: Closest to the current logo, with a softer silhouette.
A little more personality for the same familiar taco.
Golden shell #F7C96B / toasted outline #593C29 / lettuce #8FCB83 / blush #ED9271. Current app artwork stays unchanged.
